answers.core: I believe this is a essential feature for a game engine.
answers.workaround: You can control the layering of nodes using code to achieve the layering effect, eliminating the need for z-index. However, if the unit is composed of four directions, it will be very troublesome to modify the unit direction without using z-index, and the workload will increase several times.
